title: 2nd Stopping Place 5th Truth The Unity Of Name And Act And The All Encompassing Nature Of Elements And Species

questions.question: What covers the whole earth in the passage?
questions.answer: The basic materials of creation cover the whole earth.

questions.question: What else is spread all over the earth besides the elements?
questions.answer: Different kinds of living and created things are spread all over it.

questions.question: What do these things show about Allah?
questions.answer: They show that one Allah made and owns them.

questions.question: Why does their being spread everywhere help prove oneness?
questions.answer: Because the same kinds are found across the earth in an ordered way, so they point to one Maker.

questions.question: How are the elements described in relation to that one Maker?
questions.answer: They are like obedient servants.

questions.question: How are the different species described in relation to that one Maker?
questions.answer: They are like well-trained soldiers.

questions.question: What do the words about servants and soldiers help us understand?
questions.answer: They help us understand Allah’s great power and control.

questions.question: Does the passage say there are many owners of creation or one owner?
questions.answer: One owner.

questions.question: What does the writer do after giving this short proof?
questions.answer: He says this truth is explained more fully in other places and keeps this part brief.

questions.question: After these truths, who speaks to his own heart?
questions.answer: The traveler speaks to his heart.

questions.question: In the passage, what is said about the building blocks of creation on earth?
questions.answer: They are found all across the earth.

questions.question: What is said about the groups of created things on earth?
questions.answer: Each kind is spread widely over the earth.

questions.question: What sign do these groups carry?
questions.answer: They carry a sign that points to unity.

questions.question: If many kinds are spread across the world in this way, what does that tell us about their Maker?
questions.answer: It tells us they come from one Maker.

questions.question: What does the passage say about who these things belong to?
questions.answer: They belong to a single being.

questions.question: What picture is used for the elements?
questions.answer: They are pictured as strong servants that obey.

questions.question: What picture is used for the species?
questions.answer: They are pictured as disciplined soldiers.

questions.question: What can we infer about the Maker from these two pictures?
questions.answer: He is very powerful and rules over all of them.

questions.question: Why is the explanation here short?
questions.answer: Because the fuller explanation was already given elsewhere.

questions.question: What feeling leads the traveler to speak to his heart after the Five Truths?
questions.answer: Strong faith and happiness in Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What two big parts of creation are talked about in this passage?
questions.answer: The elements and the different species.

questions.question: Where are the elements found?
questions.answer: Throughout the whole earth.

questions.question: Where are the species found?
questions.answer: They are spread throughout the earth too.

questions.question: What important lesson comes from both being spread everywhere?
questions.answer: The lesson is that they all come from one Lord.

questions.question: What does the passage say about their ownership?
questions.answer: They are all owned by one being.

questions.question: In the comparison, what are the elements like?
questions.answer: They are like servants that follow commands.

questions.question: In the comparison, what are the species like?
questions.answer: They are like trained soldiers spread out over the earth.

questions.question: What quality of Allah is especially clear in this part?
questions.answer: His oneness and mighty power.

questions.question: What happens after this short indication is given?
questions.answer: The traveler sums up what he learned from the Five Truths and speaks from his heart.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the reach of the elements of creation?
questions.answer: Their reach is over the whole earth.

questions.question: What does it teach about each kind of created thing?
questions.answer: Each kind is spread across the earth as one united kind.

questions.question: What does that united spread point to?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What is proven very clearly by the elements and species being everywhere?
questions.answer: That one being made them and they belong to Him.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the one who controls the huge elements?
questions.answer: He is unique and very powerful.

questions.question: What job-like picture is given for the elements?
questions.answer: They are like servants carrying out orders.

questions.question: What job-like picture is given for the species on earth?
questions.answer: They are like soldiers lined up with discipline.

questions.question: What do both pictures show about creation?
questions.answer: Creation is under one command.

questions.question: Why does the passage end this part quickly?
questions.answer: Because it says this truth has already been explained elsewhere.

questions.question: What is everywhere on earth according to the passage: only a few materials or the elements of creation?
questions.answer: The elements of creation are everywhere on earth.

questions.question: Are the species shown as scattered with no order or spread as united kinds?
questions.answer: They are spread as united kinds.

questions.question: What does this spread say about the source of these things?
questions.answer: Their source is one being.

questions.question: What does this spread say about who owns them?
questions.answer: One being owns them.

questions.question: What does the passage compare the great elements to?
questions.answer: To obedient servants.

questions.question: What does the passage compare the species to?
questions.answer: To well-trained soldiers.

questions.question: What can a student learn about Allah from this order and spread?
questions.answer: Allah is one and has power over all creation.

questions.question: Does this part give every detail or just a short reminder?
questions.answer: Just a short reminder.

questions.question: After remembering the Five Truths, what does the traveler do?
questions.answer: He speaks to his heart with joy and faith.

questions.question: What is the main idea of this short passage?
questions.answer: The world’s elements and species show that Allah is one.

questions.question: What fact about the elements helps teach this lesson?
questions.answer: They are found across the whole earth.

questions.question: What fact about the species helps teach the same lesson?
questions.answer: They are also spread across the earth.

questions.question: What kind of sign do these species carry?
questions.answer: A sign pointing to unity.

questions.question: When many parts of creation are connected in this way, what does that tell us about their Maker?
questions.answer: It tells us their Maker is one.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the relationship between these created things and that one Maker?
questions.answer: They are His products and under His command.

questions.question: How are the elements shown to act under His command?
questions.answer: Like servants that obey.

questions.question: How are the species shown to act under His command?
questions.answer: Like disciplined soldiers.

questions.question: What feeling comes after the traveler sees these truths?
questions.answer: He feels strong faith and joy in Allah’s unity.

questions.question: Who does the traveler speak to in the end of the marked passage?
questions.answer: He speaks to his heart.
